facts.fact: Linear TV ad spending is expected to decrease more than 11% globally in 2026, reaching $139.1 billion USD, according to EMARKETER as cited by the page.
facts.quote: ad spend expected to [decrease more than 11% globally](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/linear-tv-ad-spend-decline-deepens-viewer-attention-shifts) in 2026, reaching $139.1 billion USD

facts.fact: Linear TV ad spend accounted for 12.4% of global media spend, compared to 41.3% in 2013, per the page.
facts.quote: linear TV ad spend now accounts for 12.4% of global media spend compared to 41.3% in 2013

facts.fact: The average US adult is expected to spend three hours and 41 minutes watching CTV per day in 2026, a 24.9% increase from 2023.
facts.quote: The average US adult is expected to spend [three hours and 41 minutes](https://forecasts-na1.emarketer.com/64835605c517d1f75a67fb0c/6483525cc517d1f75a67fb04) watching CTV per day in 2026

facts.fact: EMARKETER expects CTV ad spending to grow at consistent double-digit annual rates until 2028, when it officially surpasses traditional linear TV ad spending for the first time.
facts.quote: consistent [double-digit annual growth rates](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/one-of-largest-sources-of-new-video-ad-inventory-spending-ctv) between now and 2028 when it officially surpasses traditional linear TV ad spending

facts.fact: According to the IAB, the average marketer reallocated 36% of linear TV ad spend to CTV in 2025.
facts.quote: the average marketer reallocated [36% of linear TV ad spend to CTV in 2025]

facts.fact: Over 125.6 million viewers watched Super Bowl LX, mainly through linear TV, per Nielsen.
facts.quote: [over 125.6 million viewers watched Super Bowl LX]

facts.fact: The average US baby boomer watches linear TV for three hours and 56 minutes per day, nearly an hour and a half longer than Gen X.
facts.quote: The average baby boomer watches [three hours and 56 minutes per day]

facts.fact: Viewers typically see an average of 15 minutes of ads per hour when watching linear TV.
facts.quote: viewers typically see an average of 15 minutes of ads per hour watching linear TV

facts.fact: Streaming ad loads are cited as one to nine minutes of ads per hour, per an eMarketer source the page references.
facts.quote: one to nine minutes per hour

facts.fact: Linear TV commands 86% of overall TV ad impressions, according to a MediaPost article cited by the page.
facts.quote: linear TV commanding [86% of overall TV ad impressions]

facts.fact: The average CPM for streaming TV ads ranges from $10 to $30 USD, per an eMarketer digital video forecast cited by the page.
facts.quote: The average CPM ranges from $10 to $30 USD

facts.fact: Only three major streaming services are predicted to have CPMs higher than $30 USD in 2026.
facts.quote: with only three major streaming services predicted to have higher CPMs than $30 USD in 2026

facts.fact: Traditional pay TV households are projected to drop from 43.2 million in 2026 to 33 million by 2030, per an eMarketer forecast cited by the page.
facts.quote: from 43.2 million in 2026 to 33 million by 2030

facts.fact: A study cited by the page found advertisers who combined linear TV and CTV achieved a 32% increase in total reach compared with those using linear TV alone.
facts.quote: advertisers who leveraged linear TV and CTV advertising achieved a [32% increase] in total reach compared to those who used linear TV alone

facts.fact: In a 2024 survey, nearly half of marketers said CTV and primetime linear TV inventory were equally valuable.
facts.quote: In a 2024 survey, when asked what type of inventory was more valuable—CTV or primetime linear TV—nearly half of marketers surveyed said the two were equally valuable.

facts.fact: Linear TV is television programming consumed at a set time on a set TV channel, while non-linear TV is typically streamed and can be watched at any time.
facts.quote: Linear TV is television programming that is consumed at a set time and on a set TV channel. Non-linear TV is typically streamed and can be watched at any time.

facts.fact: Linear TV is called 'linear' because viewers can watch programming only at its scheduled time and via a specific channel.
facts.quote: Viewers can watch programming only at its scheduled time, and via a specific channel.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, the best way to measure linear TV ad effectiveness is to combine short-term and long-term measurement approaches.
facts.quote: The best way to measure linear TV ad effectiveness is to combine short-term and long-term measurement approaches.
